## New Features

- Opt-in `instant_interrupt` lets new input steer Codex during model responses or long-running code-mode calls. (#48135, #48141)
- New sessions get a compact welcome screen and consistent headers, with occasional tips during and after turns. (#48513, #48562, #48352)
- The warnings viewer dismisses reviewed warnings when closed; press `k` to keep one for later. (#48205, #48206)
- You can scroll the transcript while deciding whether to implement a plan. (#48805)
- Native Mermaid rendering supports more flowchart edges, labels, and node groups. (#48814, #48895)
- App-server clients can paginate thread history from a specific item. (#48151)

## Bug Fixes

- Windows launches avoid stray console windows for MCP servers, code-mode hosts, and piped commands; restrictive launchers can fall back to embedded mode. (#48138, #48238, #48483, #48491)
- Copying transcript selections preserves Markdown tables, formatting, and significant whitespace. More terminals now copy automatically on selection. (#48548, #48549, #48469)
- Blank sessions retain drafts when switching tasks, and threads can be archived and listed before their first turn. (#48628, #48828, #48199)
- Local ChatGPT sign-in opens the browser reliably; onboarding also provides a shortcut to copy the login link. (#48502, #48544)
- Approved commands retain explicit filesystem denials, and `.aws` directories are protected by default under writable roots. (#48155, #48176)
- Fixed macOS TLS access in network-enabled sandboxes and remote environments that require proxy access. (#48565, #48198)

## Chores

- Removed automatic follow-up prompt suggestions and the `tui.prompt_suggestions` setting. (#48621)
- Removed the bundled `plugin-creator` skill. (#48604)

prs.title: Isolate realtime auth fallback test from startup prewarm
Prevent message-board notifications from reopening final answers
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Prevent message-board notifications from reopening final answers

## Why

Message-board notifications delivered as ordinary injected input could cause an agent to sample again after its final answer.

## What changed

Route notifications through the current turn's mailbox as `InterAgentCommunication`, checking atomically that the turn is running and still accepts mailbox delivery. Skip notifications when delivery is closed. Accepted notifications may remain in conversation history for a later turn without reopening the finalized answer or starting a new turn.

Report pending inter-agent communications as mailbox activity, while preserving priority for steering input.

## Testing

Add regression scenarios for notifications arriving before and after finalization, asserting no extra sampling and the expected notification presence in the next turn. Extend input-queue coverage to recognize already-pending mailbox activity.

prs.title: Avoid full metadata rewrites for thread timestamp updates
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Avoid full metadata rewrites for thread timestamp updates

## Why

Updates that only change `updated_at` should not rewrite unrelated thread metadata or its indexes.

## What changed

Use `touch_thread_updated_at` for timestamp-only patches when the SQLite row exists and the rollout path is unchanged. Preserve the full update path for missing rows, changed rollout paths, and patches containing other metadata, including staged changes.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for legacy and paginated histories that verifies missing-row reconstruction, timestamp-only writes using SQLite triggers, preservation of other metadata, and application and removal of staged metadata.

prs.title: Isolate the memory startup metadata test from Git enrichment
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Isolate the memory startup metadata test from Git enrichment

## Why

Best-effort workspace enrichment can time out independently of the detached
request metadata checked by the memory startup test.

## What changed

Keep the phase-one service-tier and detached-metadata test fixture outside Git
and assert that `workspaces` is absent. Update the header assertion message to
refer to turn metadata.

prs.title: Use a compatible PowerShell fallback for the Windows MXC sandbox
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Use a compatible PowerShell fallback for the Windows MXC sandbox

## Why

Microsoft Store PowerShell cannot run under MXC. The existing fallback to an unpackaged PowerShell executable only applied to the elevated Windows sandbox.

## What changed

Extend local PowerShell fallback discovery to MXC in `unified_exec`, using the executor's Windows sandbox selection. Keep discovery local and automatic `-NoProfile` insertion specific to the elevated sandbox. Skip this preparation for non-Windows target paths.

## Testing

Extend command-preparation tests to cover MXC and add a Windows integration test that replaces a Store PowerShell path before launch, writes a file successfully, and verifies `windows_mxc` sandbox metadata.

prs.title: Use the numeric ioctl value in the macOS sandbox policy
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Use the numeric ioctl value in the macOS sandbox policy

Older macOS policy compilers do not define the `TIOCSTI` symbol. Generate the sandbox CLI's Seatbelt deny rule with the numeric value from `libc::TIOCSTI` so it remains compatible while blocking terminal input injection.

prs.title: Clarify ChatGPT sign-in success copy
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Clarify ChatGPT sign-in success copy

Describe permissions and approvals explicitly in the Codex docs link text,
and clarify that the user's ChatGPT plan rate limits and training data

revised copy and layout.

prs.title: Avoid SQLite stalls from connection setup and stderr span logging
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Avoid SQLite stalls from connection setup and stderr span logging

## Why

Setting `auto_vacuum` on every connection can wait for a writer lock even when the mode is unchanged. Logging every span entry and exit can also block SQLx workers on undrained stderr while they hold a write transaction.

## What changed

- Set incremental vacuum only for empty databases or databases using full auto-vacuum, before enabling WAL. Preserve existing nonempty databases with auto-vacuum disabled.
- Emit span creation and closure events in app-server text and JSON stderr logs, preserving busy/idle timings and explicit events while omitting span entry and exit records.

## Testing

Add regression tests for opening and expanding writable pools while another connection holds a writer lock, and for transaction completion with undrained stderr in both log formats. Verify vacuum modes and retained log diagnostics.

prs.title: Add opt-in conversation history retrieval to Guardian reviews
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Add opt-in conversation history retrieval to Guardian reviews

## Why

The transcript supplied to Guardian may omit earlier user instructions, restrictions, or revoked permissions. History retrieval lets the reviewer check relevant authorization before approving actions with side effects.

## What changed

- Add the disabled-by-default `guardian_conversation_history_tools` feature. With Apps enabled, expose `user_message.search_messages` and `user_message.read_messages` through the parent's live Apps connection and conversation identity.
- Recheck the parent's current app and tool policy on each call, rejecting disabled tools and calls requiring approval.
- Add retrieval instructions that distinguish user authorization from assistant context and account for later revocations and incomplete results. Allow overrides through `auto_review.experimental_conversation_history_prompt`.
- Limit history responses to an estimated 4,000 tokens by default, configurable through `auto_review.conversation_history_max_output_tokens`, while preserving stricter parent and reviewer limits.
- Allow explicit extension registries for isolated sessions and prevent those sessions from inheriting the implicit Apps connection.

## Testing

Add scenarios covering history tool exposure, parent connection and identity reuse, custom prompts, output truncation, stricter reviewer budgets, and live permission changes on a reused reviewer. Extend configuration coverage for blank prompt overrides.

prs.title: Show the Plan mode cycling hint in the fullscreen status line
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Show the Plan mode cycling hint in the fullscreen status line

## Why

The fullscreen status line showed Plan mode without explaining how to leave it.

## What changed

Show `Plan mode (shift+tab to cycle)` when the composer is idle and accepts input, and the hint fits alongside the status text. Fall back to the mode label when space is limited, and hide the shortcut during tasks, popups, interactive footer use, or other non-composer modes.

## Testing

Add a rendering snapshot and regression assertions for wide and narrow layouts, running tasks, interactive search, empty status text, disabled input, and parent-owned threads.

prs.title: Preserve encrypted agent messages in Guardian reviews
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Preserve encrypted agent messages in Guardian reviews

## Why

Guardian transcripts omitted encrypted agent messages, leaving reviews without evidence such as encrypted parent replies.

## What changed

- Carry encrypted `agent_message` items through synchronous reviews and asynchronous scoring, preserving their order, author, recipient, and ciphertext.
- Account for native messages in context budgets and omit them whole with an explicit notice when limits require it.
- Support mixed text and native messages during review admission while retaining user-content annotations.

## Testing

Add coverage for transcript ordering and budget eviction in both reviewer profiles, plus a mocked scenario verifying that an encrypted parent reply appears exactly once in each of two incremental Guardian reviews.

prs.title: Copy selections within inline code as plain text
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Copy selections within inline code as plain text

## Why

Copying text selected entirely within inline code added Markdown backticks that were not part of the selected content.

## What changed

Return only the selected content as plain text when the selection is contained within one inline code span, including in a single table cell. Preserve Markdown formatting for selections that also include surrounding content, and continue filtering control characters from table copies.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for full and partial inline code selections, embedded backticks, Unicode, whitespace, wrapping and resizing, and table selections with mixed content or control characters.

prs.title: Update Pro plan display names in the TUI
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Update Pro plan display names in the TUI

## What changed

Update plan labels in the analytics views and status display:

- `PlanType::Pro`: `Pro (More)` → `Pro Extra`
- `PlanType::ProLite`: `Pro` → `Pro Standard`
- `PlanType::ProMax`: `Pro (Max)` → `Pro Max`

## Testing

Update the status display-name test expectations for all three Pro tiers.

prs.title: Add handoff-aware root context for Guardian reviews
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Add handoff-aware root context for Guardian reviews

## What changed

Add the disabled-by-default `guardian_root_handoff_context` feature to select worker-specific root evidence for Guardian reviews. Use recorded `spawn_agent`, `send_message`, and `followup_task` calls targeting a worker or its ancestors to select the three preceding root messages per handoff, plus the three latest root messages so recent cancellations remain visible before another handoff.

Preserve verified tool answers and evidence without known ordering, and retain the existing shared message cap. Fall back to the existing root context when no usable handoff window remains or the latest authorization message is a heartbeat. Update the review context revision when the selection changes.

## Testing

Add a delegation scenario and Guardian request snapshot covering ancestor handoffs, separate worker branches, cancellation visibility, and fallback after compaction removes handoff calls. Extend heartbeat coverage to exercise the new feature and verify that the latest turn's trusted skills are retained.

prs.title: Fix Windows sandbox ACL repair for long runtime paths
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Fix Windows sandbox ACL repair for long runtime paths

## Why

Runtime ACL repair needs to handle nested files and directories beyond the legacy Windows path limit.

## What changed

Use Rust's `OpenOptions` for ACL reads and handle-based `SetSecurityInfo` for updates to support extended-length paths. Request ACL-write access only when grants need updating, and share allocation cleanup across success and error paths.

## Testing

Add a regression test covering long directory and file paths alongside a short-path control. Verify repeated repairs grant read/execute access without granting write, delete, or ACL-management rights, and that already-correct grants remain no-ops.

prs.title: Update Guardian messaging snapshots for native agent messages
Update Guardian handoff snapshot for separate agent messages
Keep configuration values out of Windows sandbox policy events
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Keep configuration values out of Windows sandbox policy events

## Why

Configuration parser errors can include entire configuration lines containing credentials. Persistent policy-rejection events must avoid recording those values.

## What changed

Replace free-form error text in Windows sandbox provisioning policy-rejection events with known stage labels and typed cloud, HTTP, I/O, and Win32 error codes. Use fixed fallback labels when the stage or cause is unrecognized.

## Testing

Add regression coverage using malformed requirements and cloud configuration fragments containing a synthetic secret. Verify that diagnostics exclude parser values while retaining safe error codes, and that unknown errors produce fixed fallback text.

prs.title: Reclaim unused SQLite log database pages in the background
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Reclaim unused SQLite log database pages in the background

## Why

Deleting logs leaves free SQLite pages available for reuse without shrinking the database file. Reclaim excess free space while preserving a reserve for future writes.

## What changed

- Start a background incremental-vacuum worker with `StateRuntime`, enabling reclamation only for the logs database. Use a per-home file lock to select one worker and wait for it to finish during shutdown.
- Reclaim pages when at least 64 MiB and 25% of the database are free, preserving a reserve of at least 16 MiB or 10% of the database.
- Use short transactions with page and cooperative time budgets, defer work on contention, and reduce batch sizes with exponential backoff when interrupted passes make no progress.
- Record reclamation counts, durations, and reclaimed pages in telemetry.

## Testing

Add a regression test that interrupts a vacuum commit, verifies foreground writes can resume without data loss, then confirms a resumed pass shrinks the database and passes `PRAGMA integrity_check`.

prs.title: Surface realtime voice catalog failures in the TUI
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Surface realtime voice catalog failures in the TUI

## Why

Failed `thread/realtime/listVoices` requests silently fell back to the built-in catalog, allowing voice selection and conversation startup to proceed without the server's voice catalog.

## What changed

- Propagate catalog errors and show an error instead of opening the voice picker or starting a realtime conversation.
- If the catalog lookup fails after saving a preference, report that the preference was saved but the effective voice could not be confirmed. Leave the in-memory voice settings unchanged.

## Testing

Extend remote voice tests and snapshots to cover catalog failures when opening the picker, saving a preference, and starting a conversation. Verify that the preference is persisted, in-memory settings stay unchanged, and failed startup clears realtime state without sending `thread/realtime/start`.

prs.title: Propagate Cargo package versions to Bazel Rust targets
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Propagate Cargo package versions to Bazel Rust targets

## What changed

Expose resolved Cargo package versions in `rules_rs` workspace `DEP_DATA` and pass them through `codex_rust_crate` to build scripts, libraries, binaries, and tests. This replaces the hardcoded `0.0.0` build-script version and supplies explicit versions to the other Rust targets.

prs.title: Preserve pending environments when spawning subagents
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Preserve pending environments when spawning subagents

## Why

Spawning a subagent before an environment was ready dropped the starting environment from the child's selections. The child needs to retain that environment and receive its configuration or failure when preparation finishes.

## What changed

- Pass the spawning step's environment snapshot to children, preserving ready and starting environments and configuration ownership.
- Propagate the original owner's first configuration result through descendants, applying each session's validation and leaving independently configured children unchanged.
- Preserve pending configuration waits across executor retries. Later owner updates do not overwrite the child's inherited configuration.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for fresh and forked subagents, readiness through turn-settings updates, failure propagation to children and grandchildren, child configuration precedence, and executor retries. Add a request snapshot showing a child using `wait_for_environment` before execution tools become available.

prs.title: Avoid collecting unused Git metadata in skill analytics
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Avoid collecting unused Git metadata in skill analytics

## Why

Skill invocation analytics only needs the repository's origin URL, but
`collect_git_info` also checks the repository and reads its commit and branch.

## What changed

Extract and export `get_git_origin_url` and use it directly in skill analytics
to skip the extra Git commands. Reuse the helper in `collect_git_info`,
preserving URL sanitization and command timeouts.

prs.title: Update and centralize TUI subscription labels
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Update and centralize TUI subscription labels

## What changed

Use a shared subscription label mapping for status and analytics views. Rename
`Pro Extra` to `Pro 200`, `Pro Standard` to `Pro 100`, and `Pro Max` to `Pro 500`,
while preserving the existing differences between status and analytics labels

## Testing

Update the status plan-label test expectations for the three Pro tiers.

prs.title: Skip remote Git discovery for Guardian diff paths
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Skip remote Git discovery for Guardian diff paths

## Why

An offline secondary executor can stall Guardian approval revalidation while diff display setup searches for Git roots, even when the review concerns another executor.

## What changed

Use each environment's working directory as the diff display root for Guardian sessions, regardless of `CwdRelativeTurnDiffs`, so this setup does not wait for remote Git discovery.

## Testing

Add a regression test that withdraws authorization during a pending approval and disconnects an unrelated secondary executor. Verify that Guardian retries with the updated authorization and denies the request.

prs.title: Track app-server running turns incrementally
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Track app-server running turns incrementally

## Why

Every thread state mutation scanned all tracked runtimes to recount running turns while holding the state lock. This count supports graceful restart draining introduced in https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/12517.

## What changed

Maintain `running_turn_count` in `ThreadWatchState`, adjusting it when a runtime's `running` flag changes or a running thread is removed. Publish the cached count while preserving notifications only when the count changes.

## Testing

Extend the running-turn watch test to cover duplicate starts, two simultaneous running threads, and removal of a running thread, with counts checked against the runtime map.

prs.title: Render follow-up directive labels in the TUI and copied responses
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Render follow-up directive labels in the TUI and copied responses

## Why

Follow-up directives contain display labels and prompt attributes. Show the labels without exposing directive syntax or prompt text in rendered responses and streaming previews.

## What changed

- Render `:codex-followup[label]{prompt="..."}` as its label, preserving inline Markdown styling and source offsets.
- Replace recognized follow-up directives with their labels when copying whole responses, while retaining the original source.
- Withhold unfinished directives in rich streaming previews and avoid cropping into prompt attributes when the preview window advances.
- Preserve literal code, escaped directives, and malformed source when rendering completed messages or copying responses.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for label formatting, nested brackets and backticks, literal and malformed directives, whole-response copying, and streaming holdback across long prompts and preview window boundaries.

prs.title: Simplify startup promotions to platform-specific desktop app tips
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Simplify startup promotions to platform-specific desktop app tips

## What changed

- Replace plan-specific and Fast-mode promotions with the desktop app tip for the current platform, while preserving announcement priority and random-tip fallback.
- Share desktop app tips between the preferred slot and random tip pool, including Windows. Keep Linux app tips limited to graphical sessions outside WSL.
- Clarify installation and launch instructions for macOS, Windows, and Linux, and format launcher commands as code.
- Remove the Fast-mode status plumbing used by tooltip selection.

## Testing

Add snapshots for all three platform tips at a narrow terminal width. Update tests to cover plan-independent tip selection and platform availability.

Fix Windows path inference for opaque URIs with slash prefixes
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Fix Windows path inference for opaque URIs with slash prefixes

## Why

Opaque Windows paths encoded as UTF-16LE could be mistaken for POSIX paths when they began with `/`, or fail Windows convention inference when their leading separators mixed `/` and `\`. This prevented them from retaining the Windows path convention across URI serialization.

## What changed

Distinguish a UTF-16LE slash from a POSIX root and recognize either Windows separator in both positions of an opaque UNC prefix.

## Testing

Add round-trip coverage for Windows drive, UNC, device, and namespace paths, including forward and mixed separators. Cover JSON serialization, absolute-path joins, relative-path separator handling, and Windows-only host-native conversions.
